# Amir Iravani

> Front-end engineer in Turin with 10+ years in Angular, React and Vue. Digital Horizons IT programme at ENAIP Piemonte; open to full-time roles in Italy.

Amir Mohammad Iravani is a front-end engineer based in Turin (Torino), Italy, with over ten years of experience building web interfaces, mainly with Angular, as well as React and Vue. He has worked as a sole front-end developer on a B2B marketplace, as a CTO, and as co-founder of a web agency, and now builds startup MVPs. He speaks Persian (native), English (C1) and Italian (B1), and holds an unrestricted Italian work permit for full-time roles.

The site is available in English (root), Italian (/it) and Persian (/fa). Contact: amirmohammad76@yahoo.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://amir-iravani.it/): Front-end engineer in Turin with 10+ years in Angular, React and Vue. Digital Horizons IT programme at ENAIP Piemonte; open to full-time roles in Italy.
- [Projects](https://amir-iravani.it/projects): Selected work by front-end engineer Amir Iravani: a ten-language AI news platform, a B2B auto-parts marketplace, startup MVPs, e-commerce and open source.
